subject: stat_smooth for y-values with same x-values

messages.author: a3266bb8f38fd78e
messages.subject: stat_smooth for y-values with same x-values
parts:
Hi there !

Somehow if I want to make a stat_smooth for the following data, it
won't show me the regeression line.

x <- c(1,1,2,2)
y <- c(1,2,3,4)
dat <- data.frame(x,y)
p <- ggplot(dat,aes(x,y)) + geom_point() + stat_smooth(method=lm)

But if I change the x values slightly, it works:

x <- c(1.0001,1.0002,2.0001,2.0002)
y <- c(1,2,3,4)
dat <- data.frame(x,y)
p <- ggplot(dat,aes(x,y)) + geom_point() + stat_smooth(method=lm)

Is it possible to get this working even if the x-values are the same ?

Thanks,
Simon

messages.author: a5be32bcb3d808db
messages.subject: Re: stat_smooth for y-values with same x-values
parts:
Hi Simon,
I don't know why this fails, but a workaround might be to calculate
the prediction line by hand.

pred <- predict(lm(y ~ x))
dat <- data.frame(x,y, pred)

p <- ggplot(dat,aes(x,y)) + geom_point() + geom_line(aes(x=x, y=pred))

best,
Ista
